official_sources.title: Key Information Document - Contract for Differences (CFD) on a stock index
observations: Uses a stock-index example with 20:1 leverage and a 5% minimum initial margin deposit.
The document describes the 5% amount as a minimum initial margin, not a broker-specific maximum margin requirement.
The worked example is FTSE 100 and does not establish point-in-time US500/NAS100 requirements over DEVELOPMENT.

official_sources.title: Terms and Conditions
observations: Margin requirements are to be determined from the Platform.
Pepperstone reserves rights to adjust Margin requirements for a Contract.
Those rights can be exercised in abnormal trading conditions or where considered necessary for protection of Pepperstone's rights.
No finite maximum historical margin percentage for US500 or NAS100 is stated.

official_sources.title: What are the margin requirements?
observations: Current initial margin depends on account leverage, trade size, instrument and account currency.
Current calculation is delegated to the secure-client-area Margin Calculator.

official_sources.title: Understanding margin in CFD trading
observations: Current guidance states indices are around 5% margin.
It explicitly states margin rates and leverage depend on market conditions, regulation, trade size, instrument and account currency.

official_sources.title: Contact us
observations: Official Pepperstone EU support contact is support@pepperstone.com.

minimum_sufficient_response: A point-in-time margin/leverage schedule for Pepperstone EU retail cTrader US500 and NAS100 covering DEVELOPMENT, including exceptional margin adjustments; or

A written broker statement of the maximum margin percentage / minimum leverage that could have applied to each target over DEVELOPMENT, including whether exceptional or event-specific increases could exceed it.
insufficient_responses: A generic statement that major indices are normally 20:1 or 5%.
A statement of regulatory maximum leverage without broker historical limits.
An answer that omits exceptional/event-specific margin increases.
